## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Design-system component
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Backend/API change
- [ ] Integration change
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Dependency update

## Validation

- [ ] Typecheck passed (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint passed (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Unit/component tests passed (`npm test`)
- [ ] Storybook updated where relevant
- [ ] Playwright tests updated where relevant
- [ ] Accessibility checked where relevant (axe-core, keyboard, screen reader)
- [ ] API contract updated where relevant
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Screenshots / recordings

Add before/after screenshots for UI changes.

## Accessibility checklist (for UI changes)

- [ ] Keyboard operable
- [ ] Visible focus state
- [ ] Screen reader announcement verified
- [ ] Colour contrast verified
- [ ] No new axe-core critical/serious violations

## Risk and rollback

Describe risk, feature flags and rollback plan.
